label: template-phrase-cleanup.mjs produces an exact machine-readable preview: --json emits per-file changes and skipped-file diagnostics, the summary counts files/skips/errors, and every skip prints as path: skipped: reason; dry runs write nothing.

The skip class is real and was routed by hand: phase 12 skipped 21 files for no opening frontmatter delimiter and fixed them outside the tool (field copies plus lane work); the tool reports them but no tool routes them to fill-frontmatter.

The live-packet apply is documented at commit level: 1,319 files in 541 live folders, archived left alone, per-folder metadata re-derived, second run finds nothing; the commit body carries claims the repo checks re-derive only in part.
The phase close commit rebuilt the trigger index from the final corpus and states its freshness check passes, so the index is verified locally within the same work.

Applied-state verification remains manual where volume is highest: phase 013 names sampled diffs as the control for thousands of structural edits and the phrase applies sampled 10 previews; sampling is not repeatable or machine-checkable.

The pieces for a machine check exist: the dry-run preview fully describes the intended change, so an applied-state audit is a base-revision preview compared against the working tree, not new heuristics. (INFERRED; confirm by prototyping the audit against one applied folder.)
